conversations.response:
Days like that can be completely exhausting, especially when it feels like one thing after another keeps piling on. It is really tough when a morning starts off on the wrong foot and the rest of the day just follows suit. 

Was there one specific moment that threw things off, or did a bunch of small things just add up?

conversations.name: Academic Stress Expression
conversations.response:
Facing an urgent deadline tomorrow while trying to prepare for three major exams next week is a huge weight to carry all at once. It makes total sense that it feels like too much right now. 

Are you able to focus on just the assignment for the moment, or is everything competing for your attention at the same time?

conversations.name: University Group Project Problem
conversations.response:
Carrying an entire group project by yourself right before a major deadline is exhausting and deeply unfair. You shouldn't have to bear everyone else's workload just to get it submitted. 

Are you trying to push through and finish it all yourself, or are you thinking about reaching out to your professor?

conversations.name: Explicit No-Advice Request
conversations.response: Take all the space you need. No advice, tips, or quick fixes here—just an open space for you to let it out. What happened today that made things so frustrating?

conversations.name: Multi-Turn Conversational Continuity
conversations.response:
That kind of silence can make the hurt feel so much sharper, especially when you just want to clear the air. It leaves you carrying all that uncertainty alone. 

How are you holding up right now?
